description: Synchronizes installed profiles (in QGIS profiles folder) from downloaded ones in QDT working folder.
title: QProfiles Synchronizer

qdt_watermark.description: Where to write QDT metadata (profile version, author and contact email, QDT version, last synchronization date) in the settings file (QGIS3.ini, QGIS4.ini...) of synchronized profiles: nowhere, in a dedicated [QDT] section or in the [variables] section (global expression variables visible by end-users).

sync_mode.description: Synchronization mode to apply with profiles.
